gadai-credit.description: Gadai credit report for any Bankr Doppler token on Base: live creator-fee history (Bankr public API) run through Gadai's deterministic underwriting engine. Returns fee run-rates (r7/r30/lifetime, slope, cv), the max USDC credit line the fee stream supports (30% advance x 14d, $250 cap), fee rate, CCA floor price, term, eligibility and the full formula with numbers plugged in.

token.description: Bankr Doppler token address on Base (0x..., 40 hex chars), e.g. 0x5F980Dcfc4c0fa3911554cf5ab288ed0eb13DBa3

borrower.description: Optional wallet (0x...). If set, the report is ineligible unless it is the token's fee beneficiary.

symbol.description: Token symbol, null if not a Bankr Doppler token

beneficiary.description: Fee beneficiary the history belongs to

sharePct.description: Beneficiary share of pool fees, percent

history.description: Fee history in WETH (days = calendar days since first fees)

slope30d.description: Least-squares slope of the 30d daily series

cv30d.description: Coefficient of variation of the 30d daily series (null if no fees)

terms.description: Engine terms at the max principal (null when below $1)

eligible.description: Would Gadai pre-approve a loan (on-chain checks run at apply time)

formula.description: Full engine formula with the live numbers plugged in
